_comment: THE SCHEDULER, and there must be exactly one of it.
NO `exec` prefix. Railway's Dockerfile builder runs the start command
directly as PID 1 with no shell, so the first token must be a real
binary -- `exec` is a shell builtin and fails with "The executable
`exec` could not be found". It is also unnecessary: running as PID 1 is
exactly what it was for, and this builder already does it.
Beat only PRODUCES: it puts due tasks on the broker and consumes
nothing. So it needs no -Q, and it does no work itself. If this service
is running and no worker consumes 'publish', posts still never publish.
Run this OR `worker --beat`, never both. Two schedulers fire every
periodic task twice. periodic_lock.py makes that harmless rather than
corrupting, but harmless is not intended.
Replicas: exactly 1. Beat has no leader election of its own.
